requirement: Implicit untaken/taken continuation is a defined outcome
notes: There is no else clause, so the false outcome has no line of its own to hit -- it is defined as 'line 6 not reached, execution falls through to line 7.' A provider must treat this as a legitimate, fully-covered false outcome when both inputs are run, not as an uncoverable or ambiguous branch. Line 5 (`if value > 0:`) is a decision line, deliberately not listed as a body-line obligation here -- see F020's ambiguities note for why this project's current Obligation schema doesn't yet represent decision/branch points distinctly from statement lines.
